_about: Denisse's model choices, in one place (AGENTS.md Rule 0). Each entry: why, the env var that overrides it (still wins when set), and the value used otherwise. model_config.py reads this; DENISSE_CONFIG points at another copy (tests, a private tweak).

chat.why: The Ollama model the brain talks to. Must be pulled locally; num_ctx 8192 must fit the 8 GB GPU (AGENTS.md). Change it only after scripts/model_bakeoff.py and eval/run_eval.py.

whisper.why: faster-whisper size for speech-to-text. small.en is ~480 MB, downloaded once; it shares the GPU with the chat model (stt_whisper.py docstring).

vosk.why: Vosk offline model slug used by scripts/download_vosk_model.py. Keep it alongside other speech model choices so a different local model is just a config change.

vosk_model_url.why: Official Vosk download URL for the selected model. This keeps the URL near the model slug and remains overrideable by environment.

settings._about: Who Denisse works for and which of his folders she may hand out (settings.py; AGENTS.md Rule 0). The vault, home and repo are not set here: settings.py takes them from DENISSE_VAULT / DENISSE_HOME / DENISSE_REPO, else discovers them (Obsidian's registered vault, the OS home, this checkout). config.example.json lists every key. '~' = home, '{vault}' = the vault.
settings.user_about: a second-year Biomedical Engineering student at King's College London
settings._read_dirs: Folders a delegated Claude may READ (delegate.py), in this order. A fixed list on purpose, never discovered: adding a folder widens what it can see (Chuen, 2026-11-03).
settings._eval_dir: Where eval/run_eval.py files a full run's report (a subset or --out goes elsewhere).
